purpose: Exhaust the boundary-fixed simplicial collapse family for the minimal stellar triangle remesh and test local diagonal metric compatibility.

family.boundaryRule: vertices 0,1,2 remain fixed; centre vertex 3 must map to one coarse vertex

result.conclusion: All three simplicial collapses are exact cochain retracts, and all three have one-way projector support in every degree. No strictly positive diagonal metric can make their reconstruction projectors self-adjoint.

boundary.proved: finite no-go for boundary-fixed simplicial vertex collapses of this one-face stellar subdivision
boundary.notProved: no-go for general weighted cochain maps, other subdivisions, block-local Hodge matrices or finite-element commuting projections
boundary.nextRoute: enlarge the transport family beyond vertex maps or accept sparse block couplings as the minimal local metric unit

verdict: The first nontrivial remesh family closes the gauge/retract gates but not the positive diagonal-Hodge gate. The obstruction is family-wide rather than an artefact of choosing which original vertex receives the centre.
